provider: NCI Gadi /g/data (Australia) — 110+ PB persistent parallel filesystem, allocation-gated

free_tier.stated: Infrastructure is huge — '/g/data4-7 | 110+ PB | Persistent Storage', 'Massdata | 70+ PB' — but there is no free self-service quota: bytes come from the merit-based Adapter scheme or a share of a funded project. Adapter is 'temporarily closed. It is scheduled to reopen in Q4 2026'.

egress.terms: Not documented as metered, but access is via NCI systems and Globus rather than public HTTP; there is no public-bucket download path like Allas or OSN.

tooling: POSIX/Lustre on Gadi, Globus for transfer. No S3 endpoint in the storage-systems page.
chaining: Adapter is quarterly and 'designed to identify meritorious research projects which need flexible compute access over a short period' — the short period is the anti-multiplier; you would be re-applying every quarter.
limits_note: per-object-cap: n/a (POSIX). Retention: /scratch is job-scoped, /g/data is persistent for the project. request-rate: n/a. Gate: Australian institution + merit review; Adapter currently CLOSED until Q4 2026.
reliability_note: Closed scheme — nothing to get today.
